sources.title: Princess Zelda
sources.excerpt: Across incarnations, common designs include blonde or brown hair, blue or green eyes, pointed ears, and white/lavender gown with gold accents.

sources.title: Princess Zelda
sources.excerpt: Zelda is an incarnation-based character from the Hyrule royal family with designs varying by game.

profiles.notes: Cross-incarnation common traits only; game-specific Zeldas remain separate.

features.value: Blonde hair is a common design
Blue eyes are a common design
White or lavender gown with gold accents is common
